value.rationale: Determines exactly which rung-occupancy Fourier modes are identifiable in the constrained dimer ensemble, with an intrinsic even-ring alternating conservation law. Sharp finite condition ratios and the complete near-null critical profiles identify a motivated finite-size fugacity scale (lambda~1/n) where reconstruction instability switches from quadratic to finite, and exhibit a factor-four parity split. The precise parametric spectral response is not a counting exercise or an arbitrary finite slice.
